name: Forks
what: You fork a computer, or one of its checkpoints, and the fork lives its own life with its own display, while the computer it came from loses nothing. The fork gets a new identity, with its scheduled jobs and named services off, so it never repeats what its source does. It gets no secrets, no access to repositories of its own and no push unless you, or a rule you set, give it more, and never more than its parent has.
